name: Compute Cluster S01: NaN Production
description: Tests: where() produces NaN (not zero), conditional_select for multi-way branching with NaN fallback.
source:
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close)
big_up = ret > 0.01
big_moves = where(big_up, ret)
# === CONDITIONAL_SELECT: multi-way NaN-safe branching ===
is_big_up = ret > 0.02
is_big_down = ret < -0.02
direction = conditional_select(is_big_up, 1.0, is_big_down, -1.0, 0.0/0.0)

xy_lines(title='NaN Production', category='NaN', series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Big Moves', color=Color.Blue)]))(x_values=index(), y_values=big_moves)
